cases.prompt: User: 'Package the audit for my manager as a document.'
must: writes a .md report following the shared skeleton and hands back the file path
groups findings by root cause with severity and affected-page counts
must_not: dumps a page-by-page list without grouping

cases.prompt: Open critical findings exist on the reported surface.
must: sets the verdict to FIX, not SHIP
must_not: reports SHIP while critical findings are open

cases.prompt: Open mode; the user asks when each issue first appeared.
must: says history is unavailable at this tier

cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User wants the fixed-issues history included.
must: reads /api/v1/sites/{slug}/issues with status filters and reports first-seen and fixed timestamps
must_not: mixes fixed and open issues into one undifferentiated count

cases.prompt: User: 'Actually dig into why the LCP is bad on those pages.'
must: routes the interactive diagnosis to site-audit
must_not: starts diagnosing inside the packaging skill
